devices.title: My devices
devices.subtitle: Machines connected with the AutoSkill command line tool.
devices.notOnPypi: The package is not on PyPI: this server distributes it.
devices.noWheel: This server publishes no autoskill-local wheel yet, so there is nothing to install from here.
devices.assistantSkill: The third line installs the skill that teaches your agent to work with AutoSkill — without it, it will not know what to do when you ask it to automate something.
devices.thisMachineHelp: Read by the AutoSkill browser helper ({{version}}) — what is on disk right now, not what was last reported.
devices.helperHelp: A one-off setup that lets this page install skills and run trials on your machine, so you never have to copy a command again.
devices.helperLastStep: The script installs everything and needs no administrator. One step is left to you and only the browser can do it: open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, and choose Load unpacked on the folder the script names. Chrome has not allowed an extension to be installed from a local file since version 33.
